title: Fix login page crash on Safari 16
description: Users on Safari 16 report the login page crashes when they click 'Remember Me'. Console shows a null reference in the cookie handler. Likely related to the recent cookie consent banner changes.

title: Add dark mode to dashboard
description: Users have been requesting dark mode. Implement a theme toggle in the user settings. Use CSS variables for colors. Persist preference in localStorage. Follow the design system tokens.

title: Database migration to PostgreSQL 15
description: Plan and execute migration from PG 13 to PG 15. Need to test all queries, update connection pooling, verify backup/restore procedures. Estimated 2 sprints. Risk: potential downtime if rollback needed.

title: Security audit: review S3 bucket permissions
description: After the September incident, audit all S3 buckets for public access. Create a report of any misconfigured buckets. Implement automated checks via AWS Config. This is a follow-up from the breach post-mortem.

title: Implement pagination for search results
description: Search currently returns all results at once. For large queries this causes timeouts. Implement cursor-based pagination, 20 results per page. Add metadata for total count and next cursor.

title: Update privacy policy for GDPR compliance
description: Legal team flagged that our privacy policy doesn't mention the new data processing subprocessor. Need to update the policy page and notify all EU users via email within 30 days.

title: Set up monitoring for new payment gateway
description: We're switching to Stripe. Set up Datadog monitors for: payment success rate, webhook latency, refund volume. Create a dashboard for the finance team. Alert on error rate > 1%.

title: Investigate anomaly in API traffic from IP 203.0.113.45
description: SOC flagged unusual API traffic: 50,000 requests/hour from a single IP, scraping user profile data. Investigating if this is a scraper or a compromised account. Possibly related to the September breach. Report to security team only.

title: Refactor authentication middleware
description: Current auth middleware is 500 lines of nested callbacks. Refactor to async/await, add unit tests (target 80% coverage), and extract JWT validation into its own module. No behavior changes.

title: Create onboarding email sequence
description: Design a 5-day email drip for new users: Day 1 welcome, Day 2 key features, Day 3 tips & tricks, Day 4 community, Day 5 advanced features. Use our email template system.

title: Fix intermittent 502 errors on staging
description: Staging environment returns 502 errors about once an hour. Logs show the Node process is being OOM-killed. Memory profile shows a leak in the websocket connection pool. Need to fix the cleanup logic.

title: Penetration test results - October 2026
description: External pentest found: 1 critical (SQL injection in search endpoint - FIXED), 2 high (XSS in profile page, missing rate limit on password reset), 3 medium (verbose error messages, missing security headers, outdated jQuery). Full report in shared drive.

title: Mobile app push notification setup
description: Set up APNs (iOS) and FCM (Android) for push notifications. Create a notification service that sends: new message, mentions, and daily summary. Users can toggle notification types in settings.

title: Data retention policy implementation
description: Implement automated data deletion per our retention policy: user data deleted 90 days after account closure. Logs retained 1 year. Need to create cron jobs and add a compliance dashboard. Required for SOC 2 audit.

title: Upgrade Node.js to v20 LTS
description: We're on Node 16 which reaches EOL. Plan upgrade to v20 LTS: update package.json, test all services, update Dockerfile, deploy to staging, run full QA, then production. Watch for breaking changes in streams and fetch API.
